messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PDR-9034 fired -> high 5xx rate on inference-gateway-eu (rolling 5m error_rate > 7%). Link: https://pagerduty/PD-9034 runbook: https://wiki/runbooks/inference-5xx

matt_oncall: acked via PD. I'm taking oncall. starting quick triage. any customer-facing alerts? :eyes:

nisha_eng: seeing 502/503 from gateway across multiple AZs, KV cache eviction spikes around same time. spike started ~1787659800. no deploys in last 30m.

maria_support: support dashboard shows 12 open tickets referencing 502 for EU customers, error percent ~8% for top-tier routes. CS is pinged. customers affected by streaming sessions failing.

chris_prod: quick check: ingress keepalive reset rate + route latency increased. suspect upstream auth-proxy timeouts and a small canary rollout still draining. can we reroute traffic off eu-west1 to eu-west2 for critical tenants?

matt_oncall: good idea. before routing, toggle canary -> hold. matt_oncall: running: 
```
# pause canary rollout
rdctl rollout pause service/inference-gateway -n eu-west1
# route shift for critical tenants
rdctl route apply --from eu-west1 --to eu-west2 --weight-critical 0.8
```

ops_rotation: applied partial route shift for 30% of traffic for critical tenants to eu-west2. monitoring for error drop. :white_check_mark:

nisha_eng: started increasing replica count on gateway-proxy in eu-west2 by 2. k8s scale command pushed. watching backend queue lengths.

incident-bot: PD note added: "oncall:matt_oncall - route shift + scale started".

maria_support: Customer impact update -> reduced ticket rate for non-critical customers but still seeing failures for some enterprise streaming use-cases. informing CS & AE teams.

chris_prod: I see 5xx rate drop from 8% -> 3.2% after route shift and scale. KV eviction rate still high, investigating memory pressure on KV nodes.

nisha_eng: temporary mitigation: bump KV cache TTLs for heavy prefix, enabling prefix-only cache to reduce misses. running: 
```
curl -X POST https://config-api/set -d '{"kv.cache.ttl":600, "kv.cache.mode":"prefix"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN'
```

matt_oncall: good. continuing to watch. if stable at <2% for 10m we can close PD. leaving page open until CS confirms critical tickets reduced.

maria_support: confirmed two critical customers moved to eu-west2 and sessions recovered. will follow up with tickets.

chris_prod: follow-up action items: 1) postmortem to cover canary drain timing vs keepalive; 2) add automatic fallback weighting for canary >0.5 error rate; 3) KV node mem pressure autoscale.

ops_rotation: creating incident doc draft and notifying on-call rotation for handoff in 20m.

matt_oncall: thanks all. PD status -> acknowledge -> monitoring. I'll hand off to evening oncall at 1787662000 if stable. :handshake:
